name: Burpee
notes: Record the burpee as one movement.

guide.setup: Set up the burpee with a stable base and a comfortable range of motion.
guide.execution: Perform each repetition of the burpee smoothly, then return to the starting position under control.
guide.cues: Keep the ribs and pelvis controlled, move deliberately, and stop if you cannot maintain the intended position.
guide.mistakes: Using momentum, shortening the range, or choosing more load than you can control.
